answer: Stake-weighted vouching: each attestation is a signal backed by the voucher's own stake, slashed if the vouched identity cheats. A farm of 50 sybils needs 50 distinct vouchers staking 200 credits each, 10,000 total and non-poolable, since one voucher backing many sybils eats a 50x slash the instant fraud surfaces through the audit inlet, flagged by a lantern log. Failure mode: collusion rings cross-vouch each other, but correlated slashing burns the whole ring once one member is caught.
